subject: Reprioritization — demo on hold as Clearline shifts sprint priorities
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@clearline.ai>, Clara Zhao <clara.zhao@clearline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Clearline LLM demo — Wed May 7 proposed

Hi Ethan / Clara,

Thanks for the time earlier. Based on our convo, I wanted to lock in a short technical demo to cover latency/cost profiles and a quick Q&A with your infra lead.

Proposed slot: Wed, May 7 — 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET (30 minutes)
Agenda (attached):
- 10m: Quick architecture & model variants
- 10m: Live experience + perf numbers on similar workloads
- 10m: Next steps / procurement checklist

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf, initial-sow-draft.docx

If that doesn't work, please suggest two alternative times this week.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0187
From: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@clearline.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clara Zhao <clara.zhao@clearline.ai>, procurement <procurement@clearline.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Clearline LLM demo — Wed May 7 proposed

Hi Jasmine,

Appreciate you coordinating this. I need to flag that we just had a leadership reprioritization meeting — the product org pulled a lot of engineering capacity into an immediate analytics sprint that runs through late June. Given that, we've deprioritized new infra pilots that require cross-team engagement (including LLM inference) until after the sprint completes.

Can we pause the live demo for now? I don't want to ghost — we're still interested, but the timing is off. Could we tentatively aim to revisit the demo window in mid-July? At that point we should have capacity and a clearer decision maker.

Also: if you have a short tech brief or a sandbox we can poke at on our own in the meantime, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Morris
Head of Data Platform
Clearline AI
ethan.morris@clearline.ai
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@clearline.ai>
Cc: Clara Zhao <clara.zhao@clearline.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 May 2025 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Clearline LLM demo — Wed May 7 proposed

Hi Ethan — thanks for the update and for being candid.

Totally makes sense to hold the live session while your product sprint runs. We'll put this on our internal waitlist and mark a tentative reconnect for the week of Jul 14 — I can send a 15-minute placeholder now and you can confirm closer to the date.

In the meantime, I'm attaching a 2-page tech brief and a link to a sandbox you can use without needing engineering support. If Clara or procurement want any procurement/legal artifacts (SLA, SOC 2 summary), let me know and I can send those over.

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (same), initial-sow-draft.docx
Sandbox link: https://redwood.ai/sandbox/clearline

If you'd prefer a different internal owner for follow-up once your sprint finishes, tell me who I should loop in and I'll hand off.

Best,
Jasmine
